info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Rules-v5-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Rules Retrieval API allows consumers to access the set of loyalty rules defined within the system. This API provides detailed information about each rule, which can include parameters affecting customer rewards, eligibility criteria, and other vital components. Typical users of this API include developers integrating loyalty functionalities into applications, as well as business analysts assessing the effectiveness of loyalty strategies. By retrieving these rules, businesses can better tailor their offerings to enhance customer engagement and satisfaction.

get.description: Fetches the current loyalty rules applicable to customers. This endpoint provides information regarding the different types of loyalty programs, their requirements, and benefits.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the loyalty rules. It contains criteria that define the conditions under which loyalty points are awarded or redeemed.

ListLoyaltyLoyaltyRulesRequest.description: This schema represents the body of a request for retrieving loyalty rules. It is expected to be a string format.
